## AllocatedTemporaryCopy.release() method

Delete the copy and forget it. Safe to call more than once. Only a regular file at [AllocatedTemporaryCopy.path](./runtime.allocatedtemporarycopy.path.md) is deleted: a symlink or directory found there instead is neither followed nor removed.

**Signature:**

```typescript
release(): Promise<void>;
```
